tagline: A standard library of filters, transforms, & shortcodes for Eleventy
lede: Date formatting, reading time, excerpts, RSS-safe HTML, URL handling, locale-aware numbers, & more: bundled into one tree-shakeable package, registered with one plugin line.

features.title: One plugin line
features.body: Every filter, transform, & shortcode registers under a sensible default name. Templates can use them straight away.

features.title: Works across engines
features.body: Filters register through addFilter, so Nunjucks, Liquid, 11ty.js, & Handlebars templates share the same behavior. Two async filters cannot run in Handlebars.

features.title: Take only what you need
features.body: Import from the narrowest subpath, or opt out per category or per name. Unused code never reaches the build.

features.title: Optional peers
features.body: Heavy dependencies such as Prettier, PostCSS, & markdown-it are optional peers, installed only when a utility needs them.
